notes: Which of the game's containers are not stores (Framework 0.116.0). A weapon's magazine, a charger's battery slot, a scrubber's filter holder or a toilet has a container, but nobody keeps feed in it: the Take feed from and Send products to pickers, crew-order stores and housekeeping leave them out, and crew never take from them. Names are the game's own condition, container-rule and interaction names. Player files in BepInEx/config/PhobosFramework/stores override these lists; a list you set replaces the shipped list, so write the whole list.
